_note: Demo login accounts. Display names are invented for the demo (profiles carry no names); R-4521's name is the one in the official DISP-001 chat log, and D-1187 / D-2398 are named in the official DISP-001 / DISP-002 records. Stories are suggestions for the demo strip. A driver is only ever shown a rider's first_name.

stories.en: My driver took a much longer route than usual and I paid more than I should have.
stories.zh: 司机绕路了，走了更远的路线，我多付了钱。
